name: EK-TM4C123GXL (Tiva C LaunchPad)
description: The long-lived Tiva C LaunchPad: 80 MHz Cortex-M4F with 256 KB flash, USB OTG, 2 CAN, 8 UARTs and an ICDI debugger on 40-pin BoosterPack headers, well documented with TivaWare.
notes: Legacy Tiva C platform: still sold but TI now steers new designs to MSPM0, CC13xx/26xx and C2000. Has two micro-USB ports (debug and device/OTG), two buttons and an RGB LED.
No price on TI's tool page; $22.35 is Arrow's price and DigiKey listed $28.78 (out of stock) in late 2026. The 2013 launch price was $12.99. Board size and GPIO count are approximate.
